# Parent-oriented result gallery covers

These three covers were generated with the built-in imagegen tool on 2026-10-18 in response to the owner’s request for preview marketing cards. They are visual concepts for possible learning projects, not student submissions, testimonials, physical deliverables or runtime screenshots.

- `space.webp`: isometric room concept; program `space`. Its separate example link opens the mentor’s actual Room Control demo, not this rendered room.
- `comics.webp`: fictional “Лунный маяк” cover and pages. Its separate example link names the existing “Инь и Янка” family project, whose original attribution remains intact below.
- `build.webp`: website concept “Мой космос”. Its example link opens the separately authored interactive teaching demo in `examples/my-cosmos.html`, labeled as a mentor example.

The original portrait mockup PNGs were encoded as WebP (quality 78, original dimensions) for transfer size. No compositional edits were made. CSS displays the upper illustration area; the page supplies real HTML titles, copy and actions. Every cover has a visible AI-concept badge and explicit alt text.

`sources.json` records original and delivered SHA-256 hashes, dimensions and byte sizes. Source originals remain in the owner’s generated image deliverables. No identity or contact data is embedded in these assets.
